ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the straight lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point $O$, and $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$. If $\angle AOC = 50^\circ$, find the measure of $\angle BOE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \angle AOC=50^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle BOD=\angle AOC=50^\circ$ \\
$\therefore \angle AOD=180^\circ-\angle AOC=180^\circ-50^\circ=130^\circ$\\
Since $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$\\
$\therefore \angle DOE=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOD=\frac{1}{2}\times 130^\circ=65^\circ$\\
Therefore, $\angle BOE=\angle BOD+\angle DOE=50^\circ+65^\circ=\boxed{115^\circ}$
